radiusSource: Radius 0.997091 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TIC 270471727 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract): 693,676 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.834 (0.794 to 0.874) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5271.39 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TIC 270471727 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
